description: Set (`vars`) and/or remove (`remove`) environment variables for a project, optionally for a single service. Running services restart with the new values (no rebuild). Used after a deploy returns `needs_input`. Values are stored encrypted and are never echoed back; only the key names are returned.

project.description: Project slug. Optional: defaults to rivtor.json in the working directory, else its folder name.

service.description: Limit to one service; default applies to all services.

name: env_set
title: Set or remove env vars / secrets
